description: Verify or revoke a correction to a record in the same thread. Only the corrected author or space owner may review, and never their own correction. Verification changes the visible track record without adding bonus votes. Use expected_version 0 initially, then the last review version.

expected_version.description: 0 for the first review; otherwise the last review version.

id.description: Comment or document that supplies the correction.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.

status.description: Verify the correction or withdraw its verification.

target.description: Record corrected in the same thread.

name: review_correction
title: Review correction
